speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. I understand you are presenting with fatigue, abdominal pain, night sweats, weight loss, and enlarged supraclavicular lymph nodes. These are concerning systemic symptoms. To narrow down the cause, have you had any recent travel to areas where tuberculosis or lymphoma is endemic, or do you have a known history of HIV?

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling very tired and have had worsening abdominal pain for about four weeks. I have also had drenching night sweats and lost about twelve pounds.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for confirming those severe constitutional symptoms. Given the combination of fever-like signs, significant weight loss, and supraclavicular lymphadenopathy, I need to rule out malignancy. REQUEST TEST: CBC with Differential and Lactate Dehydrogenase (LDH). Please also have a fine needle aspiration of the enlarged supraclavicular lymph node performed if it is accessible.

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Complete Blood Count (CBC): White Blood Cells (WBC) - Elevated, Hemoglobin - Slightly Decreased, Platelets - Normal. Lactate Dehydrogenase (LDH) - Elevated. Cervical Lymph Node Biopsy: Lymphocytes with a high proliferative index; positive staining for CD20.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Diffuse Large B-Cell Lymphoma (DLBCL). The presence of elevated LDH, lymphocytosis, and CD20 positivity on the lymph node biopsy confirms a B-cell malignancy, which explains your constitutional symptoms and supraclavicular lymphadenopathy. No further testing is required at this time.
